title: $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ is flat over $E_X$
statement:
For a finite extension $E$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$ and every scheme $X$, the extension
of scalars $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}\otimes_{E_X}-\colon\Mod_{E_X}\to\Mod_{\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}}$ along
$E_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ ([def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map],
[sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]) preserves finite limits; that is, $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ is flat over
$E_X$.

proof.text: Put $R=E_X$ and $B=\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$. Choose the small site and coefficient universe of [def-weil-size-convention]. The closed tensor and monoidal local-equivalence hypotheses of [lem-sfb-internal-scalar-extension-section-test] hold by [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor, det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-local-iso]. This test identifies internal scalar-extension flatness with flatness of the corresponding section-ring module sheaf, using its specified natural tensor comparison.

source.place: Tensor sentence and exactness conclusion: internal/sectionwise bridge, formerly steps 1 and 6.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-qlbar-tail-module-colimit], $B$ with the coefficient-inclusion legs $q_F$ is the colimit of $F_X$ in the fixed category $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ over the small nonempty directed poset $I_E$ of finite $F\supseteq E$. For each $F$, [lem-sfb-subfield-flat] says its internal extension preserves finite limits. Applying [lem-sfb-internal-scalar-extension-section-test] to $E_X\to F_X$ proves that its underlying section-ring module sheaf is flat over $R$.

source.place: First sentence and finite-stage exactness sentence; retains the existing cofinal module-colimit extraction.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-filtered-colimit-flat-module-sheaves] to this $R$-module colimit: $B$ is a flat $R$-module sheaf. Applying [lem-sfb-internal-scalar-extension-section-test] to $R\to B$ now gives finite-limit preservation of the internal extension in the statement. The tensor-colimit and kernel comparisons and the reflection of the resulting comparison in $B$-modules are precisely those provided by the two extracted lemmas.

source.place: Tensor-colimit and final exactness sentences: assembles the two independent extracted arguments.

proof_origin.place: Assembly of the existing cofinal coefficient module colimit, the internal/sectionwise scalar-extension test, and Stacks Tag 03EU for flat module sheaves. The blueprint route is unchanged.
